title: 1D Steady Conduction with Internal Heat Generation (FDM)
img.alt: Physical sketch of heat conduction in the bar
desc.intro: This simulation solves one-dimensional heat conduction in a bar with internal heat generation, representing, for example, an electric heating element. The ends of the bar are kept at fixed temperatures (T = 0 and T = 1).
desc.method: The numerical solution is obtained with the Finite Difference Method (FDM), which discretizes the bar into nodes and solves the resulting linear system for the temperature distribution.
py.plot.title: Comparison: numerical vs analytical solution
